titulo: Man allegedly breaks into Darwin military base, assaults ADF member and flees in stolen car
cuerpo: NT police say person ‘unlawfully gained access’ to the base in the suburb of Winnellie and is still on the run Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast An intruder remains on the run after allegedly forcing their way on to a Royal Australian Air Force base in Darwin, assaulting a member of the defence forces and fleeing in a stolen car. Defence confirmed in a statement that on Monday afternoon a person “unlawfully gained access” to the base in the suburb of Winnellie. Continue reading...
